### Properties

#### BypassCustomPlugins

```text
PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.CustomLogicBypass BypassCustomPlugins { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets which custom business logic to bypass during import.


Remarks: Requires the prvBypassCustomBusinessLogic privilege. By default, only users with the System Administrator security role have this privilege. This bypasses custom plugins and workflows only. Microsoft&#x27;s core system plugins and workflows included in Microsoft-published solutions are NOT bypassed. Does not affect Power Automate flows. Use P:PPDS.Migration.Import.ImportOptions.BypassPowerAutomateFlows for that.

#### Mode

```text
PPDS.Migration.Import.ImportMode Mode { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the import mode. Default: Upsert


#### UserMappings

```text
PPDS.Migration.Models.UserMappingCollection UserMappings { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the user mappings for remapping user references. If null, user references are not remapped.


#### OutputManager

```text
PPDS.Migration.Progress.ImportOutputManager OutputManager { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the output manager for checkpoint logging during import.


Remarks: When set, tier starts, entity completions, and phase transitions are logged to the progress file, providing a structured record of import progress.

#### ErrorCallback

```text
System.Action`1<PPDS.Migration.Progress.MigrationError> ErrorCallback { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the callback for streaming errors as they occur.


Remarks: When set, this callback is invoked immediately when an error occurs during import. This allows real-time error streaming (e.g., to a .errors.jsonl file) so errors are not lost if the import is cancelled. The callback is invoked on multiple threads concurrently, so implementations must be thread-safe.

#### BypassPowerAutomateFlows

```text
System.Boolean BypassPowerAutomateFlows { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to bypass Power Automate flows. Default: false


#### ContinueOnError

```text
System.Boolean ContinueOnError { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to continue on individual record failures. Default: true


#### ImpersonateOwners

```text
System.Boolean ImpersonateOwners { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to impersonate record owners during import. When true, records are created/updated as the original owner using caller-object-id impersonation. Default: false


#### ResolveExternalLookups

```text
System.Boolean ResolveExternalLookups { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to resolve lookups to entities not in the migration schema by querying the target environment. Default: false


#### RespectDisablePluginsSetting

```text
System.Boolean RespectDisablePluginsSetting { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to disable plugins on entities marked with disableplugins=true in schema. Default: true (respects schema setting)


#### SkipMissingColumns

```text
System.Boolean SkipMissingColumns { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to skip columns that exist in exported data but not in the target environment.


Remarks: When false (default), import fails with a detailed report of missing columns. This prevents silent data loss and helps identify schema drift between environments. When true, missing columns are logged as warnings and skipped during import. Use this when intentionally importing to an environment with different schema.

#### SkipUnresolvedLookups

```text
System.Boolean SkipUnresolvedLookups { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to skip (null out) lookup references that cannot be resolved. When false, unresolved lookups cause an error. Default: true


#### StripOwnerFields

```text
System.Boolean StripOwnerFields { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to strip owner-related fields during import. When true, removes ownerid, createdby, modifiedby, and related fields, allowing Dataverse to assign the current user as owner. Use this when importing data to a different environment where source users don&#x27;t exist. Default: false


#### SuppressDuplicateDetection

```text
System.Boolean SuppressDuplicateDetection { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to suppress duplicate detection. Default: false


#### UseBulkApis

```text
System.Boolean UseBulkApis { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether to use modern bulk APIs (CreateMultiple, etc.). Default: true


#### MaxParallelEntities

```text
System.Int32 MaxParallelEntities { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the maximum parallel entities within a tier. Must be at least 1. Default: 4


#### CurrentUserId

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Guid> CurrentUserId { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the current user&#x27;s ID for fallback when user mappings can&#x27;t resolve a reference.


Remarks: When P:PPDS.Migration.Import.ImportOptions.UserMappings has P:PPDS.Migration.Models.UserMappingCollection.UseCurrentUserAsDefault set to true, and a user reference cannot be resolved through explicit mappings, this ID is used as the fallback. This should be set to the WhoAmI user ID of the importing service principal or user. If not set and UseCurrentUserAsDefault is true, unmapped user references will be left unchanged.
